published.citation: TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 159613900: Teff: 5647 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=IV/39/tic82

temperature.note: The Washington Double Star catalogue (Mason et al. 2001, AJ 122, 3466; VizieR B/wds/wds) lists WDS 14390+6417 KON 1: 0.8 arcsec apart, magnitudes 6 and 8.9: the companion gives 6.5% of the light, which a measured spectrum would blend with the star's. The color is the Planck spectrum at the star's temperature, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
